principles: Each article must have exactly one primary module for display.
relatedModuleIds may preserve context, but must not create duplicate rendered cards.
If a title, fact, tags, source, or recommendation matches a subgroup definition, assign it to the most specific matching subgroup.
Do not fill module quotas with weak or duplicate items. If verified unique items are insufficient, mark the module as below minimum and continue searching.

academic-frontier.label: 学术追踪｜机制与人体证据
academic-frontier.definition: Peer-reviewed papers, preprints, clinical studies, cohort analyses, omics atlases, mechanisms, biomarkers, and human/animal/cell evidence that primarily advances scientific understanding of aging, healthspan, or intervention biology.

industry-progress.label: 转化产业/政策｜上市、监管、合作
industry-progress.definition: Commercial, regulatory, launch, registration, partnership, financing, and market-access moves related to TCM, health foods, enhanced health foods, beauty, healthy lifestyle, and diet categories.

subgroups.label: 转化产业动态｜上市、合作与商业化
subgroups.definition: Company launches, channel moves, partnerships, financing, manufacturing, supply-chain, and commercialization signals.

subgroups.label: 政策监管｜法规、注册与合规边界
subgroups.definition: Regulatory approvals, registrations, novel food decisions, official policies, compliance boundaries, guidelines, and regulator notices.

health-food-competitors.label: 竞品研发｜企业与品牌池
health-food-competitors.definition: R&D, clinical, patent, product-evidence, formulation, ingredient, regulatory, and launch signals from the monitored competitor enterprise/brand pool.

subgroups.label: 健食竞品｜企业
subgroups.definition: Health food, supplement, functional nutrition, Chinese tonic, sleep, probiotic, cognition, vision, joint, energy, and evidence signals tied to monitored health-food competitors.

subgroups.label: 女性健康竞品｜企业
subgroups.definition: Menstrual, menopause, urinary, reproductive, sleep, mood, fertility, and female life-stage product/evidence signals tied to monitored women's-health competitors.

subgroups.label: 美妆竞品｜集团/品牌池
subgroups.definition: Skin aging, cosmetics, skincare, personalization, beauty retail, collagen, dermis, facial, lip, and beauty technology signals tied to monitored beauty groups or brands.

subgroups.label: 汤臣倍健企业档案｜健食 + 女性健康共用
subgroups.definition: Only items explicitly about BY-HEALTH/Tomson By-Health. The enterprise profile is stored once and may be referenced from health-food and women's-health analysis.

food-ingredients.label: 中草药/保健食品｜原料与证据设计
food-ingredients.definition: Ingredient, botanical, TCM, novel food, dosage, specification, safety, efficacy-claim, and human-evidence design signals that are more about raw material or evidence architecture than a specific competitor.

subgroups.label: 原料动态｜新原料、活性成分与供应合作
subgroups.definition: New ingredients, active compounds, botanical extracts, specifications, suppliers, supply partnerships, and formulation inputs.

subgroups.label: 证据设计｜人体试验、功效宣称与剂量机制
subgroups.definition: Human trials, claim substantiation, dosage design, safety boundaries, mechanism readouts, and evidence plans for ingredients or health foods.

ai-applications.label: AI｜产业应用与抗衰研究
ai-applications.definition: AI tools, platforms, products, commercialization, aging models, biological-age clocks, biomarkers, omics interpretation, and mechanism discovery related to longevity or health products.

subgroups.label: AI产业应用｜研发平台、产品工具与商业化动作
subgroups.definition: AI used in R&D platforms, product tools, personalized recommendation, diagnostics, retail, customer workflow, and commercialization.

subgroups.label: AI与抗衰老｜年龄模型、标志物与机制发现
subgroups.definition: AI for biological age, aging clocks, biomarkers, disease-state shifts, single-cell or multi-omics interpretation, and aging mechanism discovery.
